newsitem.title: USA: LCRA shuts 600 MW Tx. coal unit for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: LCRA shuts 600 MW Tx. coal unit for maintenance.

text.p: Lower Colorado River Authority (LCRA) shut one of the three coal-fired units at its Fayette Power Project this past weekend for maintenance, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Monday.
The 600 megawatt (MW) unit in LaGrange, Texas, was expected to return to operation by early December, they said.
Fayette's 600 MW unit 2 and 400 MW unit 3 were running at full output, they said.
Company officials were not immadiately available for comment.
Fayette units 1 and 2 are equally owned by LCRA and the city of Austin. Fayette unit 3 is wholly-owned by LCRA.
LCRA is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
